findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_travel_products, recommend_japan_travel_options, check_product_availability, search_private_transfers, search_charter_vehicles, get_charter_quote, request_charter_quote, get_booking_status, list_olachill_services · Private data: search_travel_products, recommend_japan_travel_options, search_helicopter_experiences, search_private_transfers, search_charter_vehicles, request_charter_quote, list_olachill_services, search_golf_packages, search_chauffeur_services · Public sink: search_charter_vehicles, get_charter_quote, request_charter_quote, get_booking_status · Destructive: check_product_availability, get_charter_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_travel_products, recommend_japan_travel_options, check_product_availability, search_private_transfers, search_charter_vehicles, get_charter_quote, request_charter_quote, get_booking_status, list_olachill_services · Private data: search_travel_products, recommend_japan_travel_options, search_helicopter_experiences, search_private_transfers, search_charter_vehicles, request_charter_quote, list_olachill_services, search_golf_packages, search_chauffeur_services · Public sink: search_charter_vehicles, get_charter_quote, request_charter_quote, get_booking_status · Destructive: check_product_availability, get_charter_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
